_comment: Every word on the T cheat sheet. To translate: copy this file to <lang>.json (es, pt-BR, ht, zh-Hans, vi ...), translate the values, keep the {{price:...}} / {{calc:...}} tokens and <b> tags as they are, then run: node scripts/t-cheat-sheet/build.mjs <lang>. Plain words, short sentences: many readers are still learning English.
meta.title: How to pay for the T: one-page cheat sheet
head.title: How to pay for the T
head.sub: Subway, bus, Commuter Rail and ferry in the Boston area
pay.tap.k: Tap your bank card or phone
pay.tap.v: Touch it to the reader. One tap pays one ride.
pay.card.v: Reusable. Add money or a pass. Get one from a station machine or staff.
pay.ticket.v: From any station machine. For a few rides or a 1-day pass.
pass.rule: Ride a few times a week? Just tap. Ride almost every day? Get a pass.
pass.day.deal: {{calc:dayRides}} or more subway rides in 1 day
pass.week.deal: {{calc:weekTrips}} or more round trips in 7 days
pass.month.deal: A round trip on {{calc:linkDays}} or more days a month
pass.bus.deal: A bus round trip on {{calc:busTrips}} or more days a month
pass.note: Round trip = there and back. Passes go on a CharlieCard or CharlieTicket, not on a bank card or phone.
xfer.time: Change within 2 hours and pay less.
xfer.note: Tap the same card or phone each time. No discount with cash.
save.free.blind: People who are legally blind, and a guide
save.free.75: Age 75 and older with a Mass ID, no license
save.half.disability: People with a disability or a Medicare card
save.half.income: Age 18 to 64 on SNAP, MassHealth or other aid
save.half.students: Middle and high school students: ask your school
save.apply: First get a card at mbta.com/fares/reduced or call 617-222-3200 (help in 160+ languages).
job.work: Have a job? Ask your employer about commuter benefits. Many pay part of your pass or let you buy it before taxes.
job.school: In college? Ask your school about a lower-price student pass.
foot.shift: See when your bus or train is coming. Shift, the free app from Green Streets Initiative, shows live arrivals near you.
